gaps.actionable_gap: Move POCS declipping beyond 2048-sample synthetic offline blocks

gaps.actionable_gap: Run sparse-constrained, SPADE and C-OMP declipping at matched geometry

gaps.owner_note: No component owner has a locally executed sparse declipper; linked feasibility, research-control and external-adapter rows are scoping leads, not capabilities.

gaps.owner_note: No component owner covers saturation restoration; linked implementation rows own level control and the foundation row owns evidence rules, not lost-signal recovery.

gaps.evidence_gap: S31 is a search excerpt; no source checkout, exact checkpoint, license review, clipped-speech cohort or local output exists for the ML family.
